# ⚒️ Mythic Maces

Unleash the power of **10 legendary maces**, each infused with unique magic, devastating abilities, and powerful passives.

Every Mythic Mace can only be **forged once per world**, making each weapon a true legendary artifact worthy of its owner.

Supports **Paper 1.21.1+**

---

# ✨ Features

* ⚒️ 10 Unique Legendary Maces
* 🧙 Unique Passive Ability for every mace
* 🖱️ Right Click Ability
* 🖱️ Shift + Right Click Ability
* 💥 Shift + Left Click Ultimate
* ⏳ Individual cooldowns
* 🌍 Every legendary mace can only be crafted **once per world**
* 📜 Custom crafting recipes
* 📖 Beautiful GUI showing every legendary mace
* 👑 Admin commands
* ⚡ Server-wide announcement when a legendary mace is forged

---

# 🎮 Controls

| Input                   | Action    |
| ----------------------- | --------- |
| 🖱️ Right Click         | Ability 1 |
| 🖱️ Shift + Right Click | Ability 2 |
| 💥 Shift + Left Click   | Ultimate  |

---

# 💻 Commands

### `/maces`

📖 Opens the Mythic Maces menu.

### `/maces give <player> <mace_id>`

🎁 Gives a player a legendary mace.

### `/maces resetall`

♻️ Resets every forged legendary mace.

---

# 🔑 Permissions

* ✅ `mythicmaces.use` *(Default: true)*
* 👑 `mythicmaces.admin` *(Default: OP)*

---

# ⭐ Forge Your Legend

Only **one** of each Mythic Mace can exist in a world.

When a player successfully forges one, the entire server is notified, making every legendary weapon a unique achievement that players will fight to obtain.
